_about: Factions and reputation, WoW style. Reputation is earned per faction from quest rewards (`reward.reputation` in quests.json) and from activities in its area, such as killing enemies (`reputation` on an enemy type in enemies.json). `standings` are the named tiers, lowest first, each from `min` points; `discount` is percent off at that faction's vendors (shops with a `faction`). Reputation-gated items and areas will use these tiers later. `renown` is the one standing that spans every faction: titles unlock from it.

renown._about: Renown: how known you are, across every faction (Fable style). Earned per quest done, per level gained, for the first kill of each elite type, and from faction reputation: every `perReputation` points gained with any faction add 1 renown. `tiers` name it, lowest first, each from `min`. Titles (titles.json) unlock from renown.

tiers.name: Nobody
tiers.desc: No one knows your name. Most don't look up when you pass.

tiers.name: A Familiar Face
tiers.desc: A few folk nod when you pass. One or two may even remember why.

tiers.name: Known
tiers.desc: Your name comes up at the inn, not always kindly.

tiers.name: Respected
tiers.desc: People step aside on the road and lower their voices when you come in.

tiers.name: Renowned
tiers.desc: Children play at being you. Their parents argue about whether that is a good thing.

tiers.name: Famous
tiers.desc: Strangers know your face before you open your mouth.

factions.name: The Road Wardens
factions.description: The few who still keep the Fallen Road open: Mara at her forge, the watch that was, and anyone who clears the dead from the way.

factions.name: Folk of the Mere
factions.description: Old Tam and the families who fish the Stillwater Mere and trap the woods around it.
